brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: The configurator refuses it. A drawer needs a half base. Its cut face blocks the corner where a spike would stand. With the drawer fitted, addSpike returned SPIKE_CLASH: "a drawer (north half) fills this corner of the junction". When the spike is the one placed first, the drawer offers disappear. A different junction or cell would be a different layout, not the same corner.

finish.summary: I did not build the requested drawer-and-spike pairing. The rules don't allow a drawer and a spike on the same corner. Only the base pieces remain on the bench, with no drawer and no spike. They are a half base at (0,0) and full bases at (0,-1) and (1,-1). I did not lock the joints, so the (1,-1) base can still slide. check_build reports the meshes as clear. I could build a drawer and a spike at different corners or on different cells if you want that instead.
